location.description: location ordinal the entry belongs to (settings LOCATION# rows). Copied — a worker or item moving location later must not restate old entries. Defaulted to "1" at post when absent, so every entry is sliceable by branch

job.description: the job tag this money belongs to (kebab-case, owner-chosen). Revenue in, parts + hours + freight out = margin per job, as a statement slice

task.description: modules/tasks task_id the work was logged against — what makes cost-per-task a statement slice, so fix work logged against a defect task IS that defect's cost

period.description: the pay or reporting period an entry settles (e.g. a pay-run period). The window the amount belongs to, not when it posted

instrument_id.description: the capital instrument (a distribution_share rule) a distribution pays. Names a rule, not a party

rule.description: the rule that produced this posting — provenance for an automated leg (a tax, a burn, a distribution)

started_at.description: start of the span an accrual covers (a shift's clock-in). The measurement's own window

ended_at.description: end of the span an accrual covers (a shift's clock-out)

issuer.description: the FIRM that issued a capital instrument, as a gerp_id — a business, already a public identity, not a private person

holder.description: the party a distribution pays, as a gerp_id. A gerp_profile_id is polymorphic, so an individual investor holding one is public by having it — that is what the id means

worker_id.description: the PERSON a wage accrual is for, as a contact_id. Never published raw: a reader resolves it through the contact, which names them only if that contact references a public profile. A REFERENCE, so someone publishing a profile later has their history resolve retroactively

role.description: the role worked, priced at the rate in force then. About the work, not the worker — a role publishes; who filled it is `worker_id`

created_by.description: the PERSON who entered the transaction, as their account subject. Attribution, so a P&L can be sliced by who booked it — resolves like any other subject, never published raw
